name: John Ellingham Brooks
bio: English translator, resident on Capri, whose life's work was an English version of Heredia's sonnets. He married Romaine Brooks on 13 June 1903 and gave her the surname she kept and painted under. The marriage was a bargain rather than an attachment on either side: she wanted a name of her own, out of reach of her mother and brother, and he wanted an income and his debts paid. He was himself homosexual — Souhami records Somerset Maugham's first affair with a man as having been with him — and Romaine left within weeks.
bio_note: Souhami, Wild Girls, p. 113. The Maugham detail is at p. 139. Dates: none recorded.
